editor.limite: Test draft. Nothing is saved and no call is changed.
editor.activacion_pendiente: Activation requires the version register and its permissions to be connected.
editor.ayuda_texto: Select a synthetic case or load its rules. Edit the date, scores and limits. Choose Validate and compare to see the effect on the same case. Export the draft before leaving: closing the page discards changes. Imported rules are not approved call terms. The breakdown shows points before the limit, the section maximum and the resulting points. Fractions are shown as exact divisions. When the result includes an overall limit, the summary shows the section sum, maximum and total. For experience, you can propose another working-time policy for the synthetic case. Write the threshold as a fraction: 1/2 represents 50% and 1/3 an exact third. These examples explain the format; they do not set a threshold for the call terms. Full-time calculation with attestation remains proportional when the case has none.
editor.bloqueado: Calculation blocked. Review the rules and case before continuing.
editor.pendiente: Edit the rules and choose Validate and compare.
editor.perder_cambios: Draft changes will be discarded. Continue?
editor.archivo_invalido: Rules were not loaded. Choose a valid configuration file up to 2 MB.
editor.puntos_invalidos: Enter zero or positive points, with up to six decimal places.
editor.reglas_invalidas: The engine rejected these rules. Review the date, scores and limits, then compare again.
editor.simulacion_fallida: The effect could not be calculated. Check that the local tool is still running, then compare again.
editor.respuesta_invalida: No valid result was received. Compare again.
editor.validacion: Review the marked fields before comparing.
editor.revision: Simulation completed. Review the breakdown before exporting.
editor.restablecer_ayuda: The initial configuration will be restored and changes discarded.
editor.bloqueo_desconocido: The case does not satisfy a rule condition. Review the loaded configuration.
editor.bloqueo_catalogo_incompatible: The case catalog differs from the rules catalog. Load a compatible configuration.
editor.bloqueo_reglas_en_grupos_distintos: Experience rules use incompatible groups. Review the applicable rules.
editor.bloqueo_coincidencia_reglas_rechazada: Several rules score the same period. Review their conditions.
editor.bloqueo_solape_tramos: Service periods overlap. Review the experience case.
editor.bloqueo_redondeo_no_exacto: The result cannot use the chosen rounding. Review that rule.
editor.bloqueo_merito_duplicado: The case repeats a merit or its evidence. Use a case without duplicates.
editor.bloqueo_regla_ausente: A case merit has no rule. Review the scoring table.
editor.bloqueo_acreditacion_pendiente: A case merit is not accredited. Use an accredited case to compare scores.
editor.bloqueo_aplicabilidad_pendiente: Merit applicability is undecided. Review the case.
editor.bloqueo_dato_pendiente: A merit date or quantity is missing. Complete the case before scoring.
editor.concursos_vacio: No competition terms have been configured
editor.concursos_siguiente: Configure each competition’s terms before starting. Employment pool rules do not apply to competitions.
editor.concursos_limite: This section does not calculate scores or allow saving or signing.
editor.minimo_formacion: Minimum duration of each course (hours, required)
editor.minimo_formacion_regla: Minimum duration of each course (hours, required) · rule {n}
editor.minimo_formacion_formato: Format: numerator/denominator. 3/2 is one and a half hours; 0/1 sets no minimum duration.
editor.minimo_formacion_invalido: Enter positive or zero hours as a fraction with a positive denominator. Reduced components can be up to one billion.
editor.restos_descartar_por_regla: Add per rule and discard the fraction
editor.restos_conservar_exactos_explicacion: Keeps each period’s exact time fractions.
editor.restos_acumular_por_regla_explicacion: Adds the time of the rule’s periods and keeps the final fraction.
editor.restos_descartar_por_periodo_explicacion: Discards the fraction of a unit in each period before adding.
editor.restos_descartar_por_regla_explicacion: Adds the time per rule and discards the final fraction of a unit.
editor.catalogo_restos_no_disponible: The remainder catalogue could not be loaded. Reload the page to edit this policy.
editor.restos_no_disponibles: The imported treatment of remainders is not available. Choose a compatible option.
editor.restos_redondeo_incompatible: This treatment of remainders does not support the imported rounding stage. Choose another option or review the rules in the file.
editor.restos_tope_incompatible: Rounding per period does not support a unit cap. Review these two policies in the rules file.
editor.restos_unidad_incompatible: Treatment of remainders requires a base unit of days. Review the time conversion in the rules file.
editor.jornada_por_horas_no_disponible: Calculation by hours is unavailable in this simulator.
editor.umbral_invalido: Use a positive fraction up to one, such as 1/2. Reduced components can be up to one billion.
editor.jornada_no_disponible: The imported working-time policy is unavailable. Choose a supported policy to compare.
editor.catalogo_jornada_no_disponible: The working-time catalog could not be loaded. Reload the page to edit this policy.
